fact: The Bank of the Republic of Burundi says it upgraded its Automated Transfer System to ISO 20022, with banks and the Regie Nationale des Postes resuming interbank operations on it from 6 February 2026.
The Bank of the Republic of Burundi reported that its national instant payment system, Burundi Pay, has been operational since March 2026.
The Bank of the Republic of Burundi pilots BurundiPay, the national instant payment system, with 17 institutions live on 4 August 2026 (BRB payment systems director Nduwimana Libere).
The BRB has acceded to PAPSS and four Burundian banks are authorised to take part, according to BRB's Nduwimana Libere.
The BRB launched BurundiPay, the national instant payment system, on 23 April 2026 and is its promoter.

Banque de la Republique du Burundi launched the national instant payment system BurundiPay on 23 April 2026, connecting commercial banks, microfinance institutions and payment service providers and integrating with the RTGS and automated clearing houses.
Bank of the Republic of Burundi launched the national instant payments platform BurundiPay, unveiled on 23 April 2026, connecting banks, microfinance institutions and mobile money networks.

The Banque de la Republique du Burundi launched BurundiPay, an instant payment system giving full interoperability between banks, microfinance institutions and payment institutions, and complementing the existing ACH, RTGS and national payment switch.
The central bank (BRB) reported gaps in reporting on the national switch meant to guarantee interoperability between providers, and named closer monitoring of the switch as a priority.
